summary: Texas couple (first wedding anniversary) got lost on snow-covered Bear Creek Trail after a 3pm start; spent frigid night out (~5F); family member reported them overdue; Montezuma County SAR + Flight for Life located them Jan 2 and extracted both by helicopter; male flown to Durango hospital with mild frostbite.
location: Bear Creek Trail, San Juan National Forest
responding_agency: Montezuma County Search and Rescue, Flight for Life
notes: Hike began Jan 1; SAR search began Jan 2; both returned to Texas. MERGE run 80: advnture.com article confirms the MCSAR Facebook post — call received Jan 2, hikers out since ~3pm Jan 1, team followed the female hiker's tracks up the trail; Flight for Life Durango extraction; mild frostbite only.
